user.title: Connect Spectrum Account
user.description:
1. Open the [Spectrum sign-in page]({login_url}) in your browser and sign in to your Spectrum residential Account.
2. After sign-in, your browser will redirect to a `{redirect_example}` address (an unsupported-protocol or blank page is expected).
3. Copy the full redirect URL (or just the authorization code) from your browser address bar and paste it below.

data_description.redirect_url: Paste the full sign-in redirect URL from your browser address bar or the bare authorization code.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Spectrum Account
reauth_confirm.description: Your Spectrum session has expired or been revoked. Open the [Spectrum sign-in page]({login_url}), sign in to the same Account, and paste the `{redirect_example}` redirect URL or authorization code below.

data_description.redirect_url: Paste the full sign-in redirect URL from your browser address bar or the bare authorization code.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Spectrum Account
reconfigure.description: Refresh credentials for your existing Spectrum Account. Open the [Spectrum sign-in page]({login_url}), sign in to the same Account, and paste the `{redirect_example}` redirect URL or authorization code below.

data_description.redirect_url: Paste the full sign-in redirect URL from your browser address bar or the bare authorization code.

error.invalid_redirect: Could not find an authorization code in the pasted URL or value.
error.invalid_auth: Spectrum rejected the authorization code. Open the new sign-in link and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Spectrum services. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while signing in to Spectrum.

abort.already_configured: This Spectrum Account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The signed-in Spectrum Account does not match the existing configuration entry.
